text:
Hari Singh: Monday KPI snapshot looks odd  launch post drove +40% sessions but signup rate per session is down ~28%. need a short narrative for execs. https://redwood.app/dashboards/launch-summary :thinking_face:
kpi-bot: ALERT: Conversion anomaly detected for campaign 'launch-jul-2026' (signup_rate down 28%). Suggested checks: UTM drift, form listeners, attribution model. https://redwood.app/alerts/6241
Leah Ortiz: is the deck using "signup" or "qualified_signup"? that will change the headline. also which attribution model is the dashboard using?
Hari Singh: public deck uses raw signup. internal uses qualified_signup for prioritization. dashboard currently set to last_touch for the weekly snapshot.
Marcus Yeo: quick query to compare raw signups vs qualified (ran on analytics):
```
SELECT date, count(*) as raw, sum(CASE WHEN lead_score >= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as qual
FROM analytics.signups
WHERE campaign = 'launch-jul-2026' AND date >= '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY date ORDER BY date;
```
Spike on 2026-07-12 in sessions with no matching qual bump. raw=138, qual=27 that day.
Talia Brooks: frontend had a small A/B change on 7/12 (variant C) that removed required email on initial submit to reduce friction. PR: https://github.com/redwood/marketing/pull/611. could be the cause.
Leah Ortiz: if email is optional on submit, our ETL may drop those events (we filter on lead_email). can we relax the filter for a short backfill window?
Marcus Yeo: ETL logs show 46 events dropped for missing email between 7/12-7/13. I'll queue a targeted backfill and relax the filter for that run. ETA ~90m.
Hari Singh: also check UTMs on syndicated partners  some creatives used `utm_medium=news` instead of `email` which shifts channel. Leah can you scan UTM variants and list top offenders?
Leah Ortiz: running a quick grep on click logs, found ~3.2k clicks with `utm_medium=news` for launch creatives. exporting to: https://redwood.app/files/utm-variants-jul12.csv
kpi-bot: BACKFILL job 2710 queued by Marcus Yeo (targets 2026-07-12 -> 2026-07-13). Status: queued.
Marcus Yeo: starting backfill now. will post completion timestamp.
Talia Brooks: I'll push a small frontend fix to restore `name="email"` on all variants and add `data-track` attr. will open PR and stage canary.
Leah Ortiz: plan: Marcus backfills & relaxes ETL filter for window; Talia patches frontend and monitors; I'll regenerate the KPI snapshot with both last_touch and data_driven attribution and add an appendix slide showing sensitivity. Hari will hold executive narrative until numbers reconcile.
Marcus Yeo: backfill complete. recovered 39 signups in window. adjusted weekly delta from -28% to -12%. Upload: https://redwood.app/files/backfill-2710-results.csv
Leah Ortiz: re-ran snapshots. with data_driven attribution, launch_email share drops from 46% -> 20%. I'll attach both slides and note the UTMs and backfill fix.
Hari Singh: good work. we'll present the conservative story (numbers post-backfill) and include an appendix on attribution sensitivity + remediation steps. leave public messaging until Monday 10:00 sync. :white_check_mark:
